design_note: Fifty Pass-1 micro-topics were sampled (eight per macro, plus two extras) and presented to a second coder (Claude Opus 4) with the five most representative documents per topic but without the LLM-generated label. The second coder marked each label as 'accept' (correctly captures the dominant theme), 'reject' (clearly wrong) or 'abstain' (heterogeneous). Because Coder A's position is constant — every label is accepted by default in the unattended pipeline — a standard two-coder kappa is undefined; we report the share-accepted metric.
